description.zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。
- 支持300、3600、14400、28800和86400。
- 不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值3600秒。
description.en:
The time granularity of the query data. Unit: seconds.
- Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400.
- If you do not specify this parameter or specify an unsupported value, the default value 3600 is used.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.

title.zh: 查询网站业务QPS峰值数据
title.en: Query peak QPS data of website services
